newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen starting steady.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen starting steady.

text.p: French shares were expected to start with a steady tone, with some operators saying the market could be supported by the Dow's 56-point rise above the 7,000 level last Friday.
However, this morning's softer dollar could inhibit market performance. Recent strength in the U.S. currency has helped the push up the value of Paris equities.

The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 9.36 points or 0.35 percent at 2,708.28 at a third consecutive closing record. The CAC-40 futures contract on GLOBEX was down one point at 2,716 from Friday's close.
